title: Fix workspace compilation with versioning strategy 3
summary: The versioning strategy 3 workspace compilation was failing because an appBuild sentinel value of -1 was passed to the .NET version constructor. The fix preserves each app's existing build component when the build number is -1 or omitted, while treating an explicit 0 as a valid build number.
key_points: Update-AppJsonProperties now correctly handles the -1 sentinel value from versioning strategy 3
Existing build components are preserved when build number is -1 or omitted
Explicitly supplied 0 is now treated as a valid build number instead of being ignored
Regression tests added to cover app and test-app version scenarios
